corridor_notes: 气化南疆天然气管道工程 (Gasification of Southern Xinjiang) is explicitly described (GEM's own ResearcherNotes, corroborated by xinjiang.gov.cn) as turning the existing 'C'-shaped southern-Xinjiang gas network into an 'O'-shaped closed ring around the Tarim Basin, connecting Kashgar, Aksu, and Bazhou (巴州) prefectures — 9 counties/cities total, raising daily peak supply from 27 to 58 million m3. Total length 2108 km, built in 3 batches; Batch 1 (2024, ~616-1126 km depending on source/date) comprises the two named trunks sourced here: a WEST line from Kuqa (near the Kela-Keshen gas field, Tarim Oilfield's main gas source, matching GEM's FuelSource) through Xinhe/Wensu/Alar/Aksu/Kalping to Bachu County, and an EAST line from Lunnan Town (on the existing West-East Gas Pipeline, Luntai County) to Korla's Shangku industrial park. A 2025-03-10 groundbreaking ceremony for '英买力至三岔' (west) + '轮南至上库工业园区' (east) — combined 510 km — was held simultaneously in Kashgar and Aksu, described as the SAME two lines. Batches 2-3 (reaching Kashgar/Hotan further out, closing the ring) are being built by prefecture-level projects that GEM tracks separately as P6230 (see that row's researcher_notes for a flagged overlap concern). OSM carries actual traced geometry for part of the east trunk — see map_or_vector.

map_or_vector.desc: Overpass pull (man_made=pipeline, substance=gas, area=Xinjiang, incl. lifecycle tags) — 25 stitched features from 56 OSM ways, ODbL-licensed. Two features are directly relevant to P7448's east trunk: one named '气化南疆天然气管道工程上库燃料气复线' (Gasification-of-Southern-Xinjiang pipeline, Shangku fuel-gas duplicate line — coords 85.171,41.773 to 85.369,41.923) and one named '塔里木油田轮南-库尔勒输气线' (Tarim Oilfield Lunnan-Korla gas transmission line — coords 84.221,41.468 to 85.623,41.872, closely matching the sourced Lunnan-Shangku/Korla trunk endpoints above). Both are tagged lifecycle=operating in OSM, which is ahead of GEM's 'construction' status for this row — worth a status cross-check. No OSM geometry was found for the west trunk (Kuqa-Bachu) or for either P6229 or P6230's branches.

researcher_notes: Solid MULTI_BRANCH result for Batch 1 (the only fully-named, fully-sourced batch): 2 named trunk lines, each corroborated by 2+ independent sources (aksxw.com regional news + xj.chinadaily.com.cn), with the east trunk further corroborated by matching OSM-traced geometry (see map_or_vector) — a strong signal this segment is either built or far enough along to be surveyable. GEM's own capacity figure (11.3 bcm/y) and FuelSource (Kela-Keshen gas field) line up with the west trunk's Kuqa/Tarim-Oilfield origin. See P6230's researcher_notes for a flagged concern that P6230 and P7448 may substantially represent the same physical southern-Xinjiang ring program at different stages of development/documentation — a human should adjudicate before finalizing route geometry for both.
blockers: Batches 2 and 3 (the remainder of the ring closing through Kashgar/Hotan, ~1000+ km) were not distinctly sourced under the '气化南疆' name itself — the Hotan and Kashgar prefecture-level projects found (and staged under P6230) may or may not be formally part of 'Batch 2/3' of this specific named project; no document explicitly assigns them a batch number. No coordinates for the industrial-park-level Shangku endpoint were found (only city-level Korla); the OSM trace's endpoint is a closer proxy.
